description: This file contains implementation code related to Git submodule configuration management, including cache handling, configuration parsing, URL validation, and interaction with the repository object structures. It manages the internal data structures for submodule configs and provides functions for reading, parsing, and updating submodule configuration from the .gitmodules file and repository revisions.

classes.name: submodule_cache
classes.description: Structure for caching submodule configuration data with hashmaps for path and name keys, tracking initialization and read status.

classes.name: submodule_entry
classes.description: Wrapper structure for hashmap entries associating hash entries with submodule configurations.
